title: Sample-weighted onboard manifest and regional-normalizer for performance claims
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Verified performance claims (latency/throughput/cost) are currently brittle across regions and sample sets. This ticket defines a pragmatic onboarding manifest and a sample-weighted regional normalizer algorithm to produce Redwood-verified profiles that are robust to regional variance and offer fair cost normalization across instance families.

Scope: Define manifest schema for onboarding runs, implement normalization algorithm in the verification pipeline, add telemetry and smoke checks, document publish contract, and produce an initial rollout of 10 curated models. This is a product-driven spec; ENG will own implementation tasks (see ENG-20412).
acceptance_criteria: Manifest: JSON schema v1 documented in Confluence with required fields: model_id, model_version, region, sample_set_id, workload_tags, cold_start_samples, P95_latency_ms, median_latency_ms, throughput_tpm, cost_per_1k_tokens_usd, hardware_profile

Normalization: Implement sample-weighted regional normalizer that computes normalized_latency and normalized_cost by weighting regional samples by production traffic estimates and adjusted for regional instance price differences
Pipeline: Verification job produces a signed perf-profile artifact containing raw samples, normalized metrics, and a stability_score (0-100)
Telemetry: Console dashboard shows normalized vs raw metrics and a drift alert if normalized_latency deviates >12% from baseline in 24h
Publishing: Publishing flow enforces a minimum stability_score >= 70 and requires two reviewer approvals (PM + Eng) before main catalog publish
Backcompat: Profiles include provenance metadata and a pointer to raw-sample blobs retained for 90 days
rollout_plan: Week 1: Finalize manifest schema and create Confluence spec (owner: PM)
Week 2: ENG implements normalizer in verification pipeline; unit tests and synthetic validation (owner: ENG)
Week 3: Run batch onboarding for 10 candidate models across 3 regions (us-east1, eu-west1, ap-southeast1) and gather telemetry (owner: ENG + PM)
Week 4: Internal review, validation against canary traffic, manual signoff and first publish to staging catalog (owner: PM + Eng + Security)
Week 5: Monitor 7-day stability; if pass, promote to hosted catalog and document release notes (owner: PM)
Rollback: Revoke published profile and revert to previous pinned variant if stability_score < 60 after publish
telemetry_contract: Ingestion: Every verification run must emit sample_count, region, model_version, raw_latency_samples (histogram), raw_throughput_samples, cost_estimate_usd
Normalization outputs: normalized_latency_p50_ms, normalized_latency_p95_ms, normalized_throughput_tps, normalized_cost_per_1k
Retention: Raw sample blobs stored with hashed provenance for 90 days; normalized metrics retained for 2 years
decisions: Use sample-weighted normalization instead of simple regional averaging to reflect production traffic skew (reason: avoids over-weighting low-traffic expensive regions)
Normalize cost using cloud price index per-region and per-instance-family (reason: cross-region cost comparability)
Stability threshold: publish gate at stability_score >= 70 and require PM+Eng approvals (reason: balance release velocity with quality safeguard)
Keep 90-day raw-sample retention window for forensic debugging; archive artifacts after 90 days with checksum pointers
